qualifications.finding: Ledger EIP-C4 is the source-bounded empirical assessment. Map EIP:C4 is guarded UCT interpretation. No explicit mapping licenses treating the two IDs as synonymous.
qualifications.preserved_result: Both can remain separately stated conditional or source-bounded claims; neither is activated.
qualifications.required_before_actual_use: Provide an explicit claim-to-map mapping and separate empirical assessment from UCT application in any future normalized candidate. Disambiguate the audit C4 witness sentence.

qualifications.finding: Global G nonidentification does not mean every observation fiber is ambiguous. Observation (1,1,0,0) has only row (S,G,X)=(1,0,0), so this fiber identifies G=0.
qualifications.preserved_result: There exist delivered-carrier twins with identical ordinary observations and different G. No decoder recovers G for all eight rows.
qualifications.required_before_actual_use: Use existential twin/global noninjectivity quantifiers. Treat the exclusive-probe assumptions as sufficient within the declared method, not a proved necessary condition for every identification method.

qualifications.finding: Rows S=0,G=1 need a type distinction if G is called actual read of the selected delivered event. With no retained-token route stipulated, gate configuration does not equal intake occurrence.
qualifications.proposed_nonadopted_qualification: Either type G as gate configuration and define the model indicator I=S AND G, or restrict actual-intake assertions to S=1 and separately specify any retained-token semantics.
qualifications.preserved_result: The delivered S=1 redundant-writer twin and exclusive-probe equation remain valid. Under the optional I=S*G typing, one intake-indicator fiber is ambiguous although three G-configuration fibers are ambiguous.
qualifications.required_before_actual_use: Bind actual source event, arrival, retention, selected read operation and time window independently. Never equate the proposed I indicator or aggregate U with a physically observed designated read.

qualifications.finding: Typed all_of does not separately name every independently required interface, delivered-carrier, sole-writer/selectivity, timing/readout or actual complete-signature/target-semantic guard. Prose and guarded conclusions retain some conditions, but the graph cannot discharge them as actual premises.
qualifications.preserved_result: The candidate can denote availability of entire guarded theorems. No actual identification or phenomenal interpretation is inferred.
qualifications.required_before_actual_use: Normalize guard nodes and simultaneous same-installation/episode bindings before promotion or actual application; independently validate all relevant physical and UCT premises. Treat structural PASS as schema evidence only.

installation_stop_condition: Do not draw an actual EIP consumer-identification or experiential conclusion, or promote the affected rule, until its applicable normalization qualifications and independent same-installation physical/application premises have been resolved. Saving or discussing the disabled candidate does not resolve them.
